title: How to Build a Travel Booking App Without Code (2026)
summary: Build a custom travel booking app with availability calendars, booking management, and payment collection in an afternoon. Database, auth, and hosting all included in Blink.
body_markdown: The booking form validates against the current` available_slots` count at submission time. If two customers submit simultaneously, one booking succeeds and decrements the count to zero; the second submission fails validation and the customer sees an "unavailable" message. For high-volume tours, you can add a short-duration slot reservation (a lock that expires after 10 minutes while the customer completes checkout) — this is a standard database transaction pattern Blink can implement on request.
